title: The Boccage brothers
summary: Wilford and Leonard Boccage played with him briefly after playing with Son Allen.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well I was going to ask about some of the other musicians over there. Did you ever play with Peter Boccage much? Any of the Boccage brothers?

No, I never did play with, Boccage, yeah, I had a boy who used to play with me, play saxophone. Oh that's right, I heard him once with you. Yeah, Wilford Boccage, he played with me. His brother Leonard Boccage, he played banjo with me too once. He didn't play that long with me. Well he used to play with Son Allen. Yeah. See, he used to play with Son Allen then, you see.
